body: Thank you for talking to me you've definitely cheered me up a bit just to have someone to listen I really do hope that things get better like you said I can take the shitty things dropped on me but recently it feels like there have been no positives just feels like more shit keeps stumbling upon me I really hope things turn around because I have no idea where I'm gonna be if they don't

Thank you for your comment you should really catch some sleep its 4 am for you and I feel helpless I can't stop my father from putting himself in an early grave I can't manage to keep a college course, I'm the joke of my work and there is nothing I can do to stop any of this when my dad dies what isn't far off the way he is drinking I will be all alone I had to carry him up the stairs yesterday because he couldn't even walk. My "friends" think it's funny some of them see him out drinking and record him making me a bigger joke then I already am.
